claims.claim: Admission Failure v2 now covers every authorized pre-RUN operation while preserving existing RUN-keyed failure handling after admission.

Diagnostics use bounded allowlisted facts, immutable observed-ref attribution, deterministic transport-versus-lineage categorization, content-addressed persistence, and subordinate best-effort transport.
Focused regressions and README documentation were updated without adding execution, retry, recovery, or semantic authority.
